prose:
Mistral has released the weights of Mistral Large 4 - Le Chonk - its flagship 1-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model, weeks after the public preview. Mistral says feedback from the preview went back into scaled-up reinforcement learning, driving what it calls massive, still-accelerating gains in coding and defensive cybersecurity, plus substantial reasoning-efficiency improvements that cut inference costs; three reasoning modes let developers trade cost against performance.

Mistral bills the release as the best open-weight model for coding and among the most capable open models overall, and leans on sovereignty: trained from scratch in Europe, fully open-weight, and customizable for self-hosted deployment.
highlights: Mistral releases weights for Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1T-parameter natively multimodal model
Post-preview RL scaling drove gains in coding and defensive cybersecurity
Reasoning-efficiency improvements plus three reasoning modes for cost-performance tradeoffs
Claimed best open-weight coding model; among the most capable open models overall
European-trained, fully open-weight, positioned for sovereign self-hosted deployments
